root_idea.summary: The root centers on attaching or hanging one thing from another, including a person attached to a group without truly belonging to it.
root_idea.development: The physical image of a dangling ear appendage or wattle extends to marks and excrescences, then figuratively to an outsider attached to a people and to the epithet زَنِيمٌ for a base or socially illegitimate person.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun is presented under its normalized citation form زَنِيمٌ.

senses.definition: An outsider attached or adopted into a people without belonging to them; an intruder or socially claimed person.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic epithet in 68:13, explained through the image of something hanging onto a group and through the sense of a person regarded as attached to people who are not his own.

senses.definition: Base, ignoble, or marked by an evil character.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative Quranic epithet in 68:13, expressing recognizable baseness or bad character by analogy with a distinguishing appendage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cutting a small portion from the ear of a camel or other animal and leaving it hanging; also the resulting mark or sign, including a particular mark made on camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun and substantive use referring both to the act of marking and to the mark itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Conjoining a person with a people or party to which he does not belong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II construction describing the act of attaching an outsider to a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sending an adversary to someone so that he may contend, dispute, or litigate with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction زَنَّمُوا إِلَيَّ هٰذَا الخَصْمُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a tree, to develop an excrescence resembling an animal's dangling appendage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The projecting part behind a cloven hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical variant of زَلَمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel whose ear has had a portion cut away and left hanging.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The practice is especially associated with camels of generous or distinguished breed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression ضَائِنَةٌ زَنِمَةٌ, a ewe held in high estimation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or exceptional usage explicitly presented as such in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression هُوَ العَبْدُ زَنْمَةً, describing someone as having the form or conformation of a slave; one reported interpretation takes the expression to mean “truly.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression with variant explanations in the classical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain leafless tree, or a tree excrescence resembling the dangling appendage of an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The tree use is connected by likeness to the animal appendage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cut portion of a camel's ear left hanging, or a fleshy wattle hanging beneath the ear of a sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete anatomical or animal-marking term; the animal examples identify attested referents rather than a general semantic restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small projection of the human ear, including the antitragus or a nearby prominence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use referring to the paired projections beside the ear lobule.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark, sign, or token.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from an appendage or cut ear serving to distinguish an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of the two edges or cusps of an arrow's notch between which the bowstring is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical archery term, also called شَرْخَا الفُوقِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain herb or leguminous plant resembling an ear appendage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare plant name; the plant is described as growing in plains or soft ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity, misfortune, or evil accident.
Of a goat, and apparently also of a sheep, having two wattles or dangling appendages.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete animal description, distinct from the Quranic figurative epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The son of an adulterous woman or a fornicator.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical figurative or genealogical usage, kept distinct from the Quran-attested senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A commissioned agent, factor, or deputy.
A lion, in the epithet الأَبَدُّ الزَّنِيمُ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic animal epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of flute or reed instrument.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained as deriving from the person associated with its invention; a vulgar variant is also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In الأَزْنَمُ الجَذَعُ, time or fortune to which trials are attached; according to another explanation, a hard or rigorous course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression with variant interpretations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel belonging to the group known as الأَزْنَمِيَّةُ, associated with a named tribal subdivision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tribal or genealogical nisbah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One attached or added to a people without belonging to them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived form sharing the outsider sense of زَنِيمٌ in Quran-focused lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small in body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical descriptive use, compared with مُزَلَّمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The young ones of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized plural use reported in Classical Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular stallion camel, or a camel described by this term in a poetic reading.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a variant reading of a line of poetry, with the form used adjectivally by poetic license.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The sign or token sense is included with the marking meaning.
The animal wattle is grouped with the closely related dangling-appendage sense.
The tree comparison is covered by the tree meaning.
This unit contains the Quran-attested outsider and baseness senses and a separate genealogical classical sense.
Inflectional pointer to the Form II entry.
The camel-mark substantive is covered by the broader marking entry.

cautions: The Quran has one occurrence of زَنِيمٌ, while the lexical evidence records several interpretations of the epithet, including attachment to a people and baseness of character.
The contextual rendering “utterly useless” is supporting context and is not treated as an independent lexical sense.
